extraction.title: Add rolling-updates feature flag and compatibility framework
extraction.head: feature-rolling-updates-implementation

greptile.text: Summarizes the PR as adding a ROLLING_UPDATES preview flag in Profile.java, gating the update-compatibility CLI commands behind it, and adding a printFeatureDisabled() helper in AbstractUpdatesCommand. It notes RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE changes from 4 to 3, a new FEATURE_DISABLED exit code 4, doc updates, a switch in operator tests from UnsupportedSpec to FeatureSpec. Confidence score of 4/5, citing the hardcoded flag in the docs template and the preview status of the feature.
"Hardcoding `--features=rolling-updates` in the template removes flexibility." Suggests using a parameter or documenting separately why the flag is needed, so users understand it.
